label: Habeas corpus dismissed
caption: IN RE KINLEY MACDONALD
text: The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis is denied, and the petition for a writ of habeas corpus is dismissed. See Rule 39.8. As the petitioner has repeatedly abused this Court's process, the Clerk is directed not to accept any further petitions in noncriminal matters from petitioner unless the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) is paid and the petition is submitted in compliance with Rule 33.1. See Martin v. District of Columbia Court of Appeals, 506 U. S. 1 (1992) (per curiam).

label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF DENIS CHARLES ENGLISBY
text: Denis Charles Englisby, of Chesterfield, Virginia, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of April 29, 2024; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Denis Charles Englisby is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
